name: Disneyland Refreshment Corner & Tomorrowland Cart Warm Cream Cheese-Filled Pretzel
brandOrRestaurant: Refreshment Corner & Tomorrowland Pretzel Cart (Disneyland Park)
whyItWorks: Soft baked pretzel dough stuffed with warm, slightly sweet whipped cream cheese—zero seeds, zero spice, and very comforting when paired with a lactase enzyme.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Order the Cream Cheese-Filled Pretzel (NOT the Jalapeño Cheese Pretzel!) and take 1–2 lactase tablets before eating.
watchOuts: Never accidentally order the Jalapeño Cheese-Filled Pretzel; take lactase for the cream cheese filling
